thread:
Ivy (Support): Escalating tenant fin-clarion: onboarding blocked at SSO callback. Users stuck on step: 'Confirm organization' view. Ticket FIN-6782. Customer on a pilot, renewal in 45d. Marking for CS priority.
Rene (CSM): Thanks Ivy. What error are they seeing? Any workaround yet?
Ivy (Support): UI shows blank after callback. Browser console: "Refused to display 'about:blank' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'DENY'". Appears only when using our embedded flow inside customer's admin console. External flow works.
Priya (Enablement): I can run a session and walk them through the external flow to get past the immediate block. Available today 14:00 or 16:30 CET. Recommend we also offer a 1-week feature-flag toggle: 'embed-skip-iframe-check' to permit temp onboarding while we fix headers.
Marco (Solutions): Confirming logs show auth server setting X-Frame-Options: DENY on token callback page. My quick note: callback should be a top-level redirect, not embedded. I'll add a small client-side shim to surface a hard redirect for embedded cases. Can have a patch branch by EOD.
Ivy (Support): Patch would be great. For immediate unblock, can we provide a temporary hosted redirect URL that the customer can use for initial setup?
Rene (CSM): Draft customer note: "Hi Clara, we see the admin console uses an embedded webview which blocks the final redirect. We can either do a quick screen-share to complete setup via external browser or provide a one-time hosted redirect URL to finish provisioning. Which do you prefer? Available slots: today 14:00 CET or 16:30 CET. 
We will also escalate to engineering for a short-term fix and follow up with a permanent remediation."
Priya (Enablement): Signed. I will create KB: 'Workaround: complete SSO outside embedded admin' + checklist of post-setup validation steps.
Marco (Solutions): I'll open PR with shim + add telemetry event 'ssowebview_embedded_callback' so we can detect occurrence. Also recommend product consider adding a non-embedded callback option in UX.
ops-bot: Severity set -> P1-CS. Assigned: Rene, Priya, Marco.
Ivy (Support): Customer replied: prefers hosted redirect URL. I generated one-time URL and attached to ticket (URL redacted here). They requested the session after they finish initial sync.
Rene (CSM): Action items:
- Priya: run KB + standby for assist during hosted redirect finish
- Marco: PR + telemetry by EOD, include tests for webview callbacks
- Ivy: maintain ticket, confirm completion, collect customer's activation % after sync
Also looping in AE (Dan) to prep renewal touchpoints given pilot timeline. I'll schedule 48h follow-up.
Priya (Enablement): Noted. Will capture UX feedback during session and file feature request if they ask for non-embedded flow support.
Marco (Solutions): If we reproduce in an isolated webview, I'll try shim first; if not stable we can enable feature-flag as fallback.
Rene (CSM): Setting internal renewal_watch tag; current activation 8%. If <40% after 7 days we escalate for outreach. :eyes:
Ivy (Support): Ticket updated, labeling FIN-6782 with escalation:cs and renewal_watch.
End of thread.
